title: Jackson routes an alias into an unwrapped record
summary: The parent created the inner record with a null component. The merge bound Hello and preserved the outer sibling World!. The merge emitted exactly the fields b and c, and the second record equalled the first.

change.description: The outer deserializer recognizes aliases of an unwrapped child.

notes: Both databind JARs came from the exact source pins. The expired Jackson core, annotations and parent/BOM snapshot inputs were rebuilt from the last upstream branch commits preceding the parent. Both deployments used the same replacements.
